annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act imposes requirements on owners of fully autonomous vehicles (as operators), insurers/self-insurers, motor carriers, the Transportation Cabinet, and local governments whose regulatory authority is limited.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the owner of a fully autonomous vehicle shall be considered operator of the vehicle for the purpose of assessing compliance with traffic or motor vehicle laws
annotation.dates_quote: amends KRS 281.764, effective August 1, 2026, to require only the lead vehicle in a truck platoon to have a human driver behind the wheel; EFFECTIVE, in part, August 1, 2026.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT relating to autonomous vehicles.
